NONE: › a stupid person
傻瓜，笨蛋
› any small object whose name you cannot remember
（不記得名字的）小東西，小玩意
C2 death, destruction, or any very bad situation that cannot be avoided
死亡；毀滅；厄運
› to make someone or something certain to do or experience something unpleasant, or to make something bad certain to happen
使註定；使必然發生

example: A sense of doom hung over the entire country.
整個國家都籠罩在厄運降臨的氣氛之中。
The newspapers are always full of doom and gloom (= bad news and unhappiness) these days.
如今報紙上總是報道一些不幸的新聞消息。
[ + to infinitive ] Are we doomed to repeat the mistakes of the past?
我們註定要重複過去的錯誤嗎？
Mounting debts doomed the factory to closure.
債臺高築使工廠無法逃脫關閉的命運。

NONE: › certain to fail, die, or be destroyed
註定失敗（或滅亡、毀滅）的

example: This is a doomed city.
這是一座註定要毀滅的城市。

NONE: › the end of the world, or a time when something very bad will happen
世界末日

example: Ecologists predict a doomsday scenario (= a time when death and destruction will happen) if global warming continues to increase at the present rate.
生態學家預言，如果全球暖化繼續以目前的速度發展下去，那麽世界末日就要來臨。
You could talk till/until doomsday (= for a very long time), but they will never change their minds.
你可以說個沒完沒了，但他們絕不會改變主意的。

NONE: › creating a mood that is sad and without hope, as if something very bad is going to happen
令人沮喪的；憂傷的

example: The film features brooding, doomy music.
壓抑憂傷的音樂是這部電影的一個突出特點。

NONE: › a brand name for a large, soft, flat bag filled with feathers or artificial material, used on a bed
羽絨被；蓬鬆棉被

門
